$comment: FACoP trusted evidence producers. A signature from a key listed here is what makes Content-Addressed Evidence reusable; an EvidenceKey alone is not sufficient. Rotate by adding the new key and setting revoked:true or not_after on the old one.

keys.$comment: NON-PRODUCTION reference key. Its private half is committed at config/reference-attestation-key.pem so this repository can self-test the attestation path end to end. A real deployment MUST remove this entry and list only keys whose private half is a job-scoped secret of the producing plane.
